 A dream date becomes a nightmare in this psychological thriller that explores themes of truth and justice adapted from British series Liar
 3 -MIN READ 3 -MIN Listen Pierce Conran in Seoul Published: 6:15pm, 4 Nov 2026 Lead cast: Yoo Yeon-seok, Seo Hyun-jin

 In The Perfect Lie , a tense Korean adaptation of the 2017 British series Liar , a cautious slice-of-life romance rapidly morphs into a dark psychological thriller about personal boundaries.
